name: vwap_band_squeeze_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, TWAP/VWAP execution algorithms from FIIs and domestic institutions create intraday volatility compressions where the index churns within a tight corridor around session VWAP. When VWAP band width (VWAP ± 2σ of price-VWAP deviations over 5 min) drops to the 20th percentile of its recent 10-minute distribution, institutional orders are temporarily balanced and directional flow is coiled. Once this coiled state breaks — price closes above/below the band with volume confirmation — NIFTY typically moves 15-25 spot points in the next 30-90 seconds as the restrained directional flow accelerates. At 5-second resolution we capture the breakout bar itself rather than waiting for a 1-minute bar to close, entering the move 6-12 bars (30-60 seconds) before slower strategies even see a signal.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(volume * close) / cumulative(volume) from session open, resets daily
indicators.purpose: Session-cumulative VWAP — no time scaling needed, it anchors at 09:15 each day regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_std_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute (60-bar) rolling std of price deviation from VWAP. Original used 20-bar on 1-min = 20 min. Compressed to 5 min (60 bars) because we trade 15-120s breakouts — the relevant squeeze is RECENT compression (last 5 min), not the full 20-min session pattern. 5 min gives enough history to distinguish compression from noise while staying responsive to the current microstructure regime.

indicators.name: vwap_upper
indicators.purpose: Upper VWAP band — close above this level on a squeeze bar signals bullish breakout.

indicators.name: vwap_lower
indicators.purpose: Lower VWAP band — close below this level on a squeeze bar signals bearish breakout.

indicators.name: vwap_bw
indicators.purpose: Band width as % of VWAP — normalized to allow cross-session and cross-regime comparisons.

indicators.name: vwap_bw_pctile_120
indicators.purpose: Rolling 10-minute (120-bar) percentile rank of band width. Original used full session percentile. Switched to rolling 10-min window because: (a) intraday volatility regime shifts (opening volatility vs. mid-day calm) make session-long percentiles stale; (b) 10 min (120 bars) is sufficient history to judge compression; (c) avoids needing the entire session as warmup, allowing signals from 09:30 IST onward.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute (36-bar) volume ratio — current bar volume relative to 3-min average. Original used 1.5x the 20-bar (20-min) volume SMA on 1-min bars. Compressed to 3 min (36 bars) because at 5s resolution a 20-min SMA dilutes the breakout-bar volume spike; 3 min retains the fast signal needed to confirm that the breakout bar is genuinely high-activity, not noise.

conditions: vwap_bw_pctile_120 < 20 (band width below 20th percentile of last 10 min — squeeze state)
close > vwap_upper (price breaks above upper VWAP band — bullish breakout)
close > vwap (above VWAP midline — directional confirmation, redundant but explicit)
vol_ratio_36 > 1.4 (breakout bar volume at least 1.4x 3-min average — institutional participation)
buy_ce.confirmation: all conditions on same 5-second bar; no multi-bar persistence required

conditions: close < vwap_lower (price breaks below lower VWAP band — bearish breakout)
close < vwap (below VWAP midline — directional confirmation)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts ≈ 8 NIFTY spot pts at ATM delta ~0.5. Genuine NIFTY squeeze breakouts do not retrace more than 8 spot pts immediately — if they do, the breakout is false and institutional flow is not unidirectional. 8 spot pts is within the typical 30-second noise range (~2-5 pts option) but above simple noise; this stop filters false positives without being too tight.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts ≈ 14 NIFTY spot pts at ATM delta ~0.5. NIFTY genuine squeeze breakouts extend 15-25 spot pts in the first 30-90 seconds; targeting 14 pts captures ~60-70% of the expected first leg. R:R = 1:1.75, and even at 50% win rate this delivers a positive profit factor of 1.75.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX 12-22 — squeeze breakouts need moderate vol; VIX>22 adds too much noise and false breaks, VIX<12 means moves too small to clear costs
filters.time_filter: entries 09:30-15:20 IST — skip first 15 min of session (opening noise), need 240 bars warmup for reliable percentile
filters.trend_filter: none — entry direction determined by which band is broken
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit orders at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — if HFT algos start trading NIFTY VWAP band squeezes at 5s resolution, the entry signal will be front-run

adaptation_notes: Original trades NIFTY 100 stocks at 1-min bars, 15-45 min holds, using equity VWAP. Key changes: (1) Moved from stock universe to NIFTY index — index VWAP is smoother (100x more liquid), driven by institutional TWAP flow, making compressions more predictable. (2) Band std window compressed from 20 min (20 bars × 1 min) to 5 min (60 bars × 5s) — capturing recent compression relevant to 15-120s holds, not the broad session pattern. (3) Percentile window changed from full session to rolling 10 min (120 bars) — handles intraday volatility regime shifts that make session-relative percentiles stale. (4) Volume SMA compressed from 20 min to 3 min (36 bars) for faster volume confirmation at 5s resolution. (5) Replaced ATR-based stop/target with fixed option premium points calibrated to NIFTY 5s squeeze breakout magnitudes. (6) Session start adjusted from 10:00 to 09:30 to capture morning squeezes after initial opening noise settles.
weaknesses: False squeeze breakouts are common at 5s resolution — single noise prints can exceed band temporarily
Volume signal at 5s is noisy — single large institutional print can fake a volume surge without sustained flow
Band width percentile needs 240-bar warmup (~20 min) — no signals before 09:30 IST; morning opportunity limited
NIFTY VWAP squeezes often precede volatility expansion in EITHER direction — directional prediction is the weakest link

original_indicators: VWAP upper/lower bands (±2 STDEV over 20 bars)
_source.original_stop: VWAP midline — reversion to VWAP invalidates thesis
